body.x: BugsBox is planning to present an online donation service based on the mobile game in ‘MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT & MIK NIGHT’ (BOOTH # 52843) of CES 2019 EUREKA PARK, the largest technology show in the world held in Las Vegas, USA for four days starting from January 8 (Tue).

This online donation service started from a question, ‘what if there is a service that can help donation without economic loss?’. Normally, the main reason why people do not donate is an economic loss.

BugsBox was developed for people to participate in donation while enjoying mobile game. Just by playing a game, a point piles up in the user’s account and allows the user to donate to the organization through donation points in the account.

The company is planning to extend the donation system into many mobile games, and it will be provided to the public the following year. The characteristics of this donation service are donation system without economic loss, donation point saving system applied to many games, donation system which anyone can enjoy without burden, and advertisement of funding partner through donation content.
One of the authorities of BugsBox stated that they will be extending the service through the purchase of games and import of cooperative games.
As a social company advancing into public donation, BugsBox has helped people to experience donating rice through games last year, and it had an effective aid to those in need.
